metadata.description: Primary references for iOS testing automation with Swift Testing, XCTest/XCUITest, simctl, xcresult, and CI environment drift checks.
metadata.title: QA Testing Ios - Sources

apple_official_docs.name: Swift Testing Documentation
apple_official_docs.description: Primary reference for the Testing module, traits, tags, parameterized tests, and migration guidance.

apple_official_docs.name: Swift Testing Overview
apple_official_docs.description: Apple product overview for Swift Testing. Useful for orientation, but verify behavior against API docs and release notes.

apple_official_docs.name: XCTest Documentation
apple_official_docs.description: Primary reference for XCTest, XCUITest, performance testing, and result reporting.

apple_official_docs.name: simctl Documentation
apple_official_docs.description: Primary reference for simulator automation and device state control.

apple_official_docs.name: Testing Your Apps in Xcode
apple_official_docs.description: Apple guidance on organizing tests, test plans, execution, and results in Xcode.

apple_official_docs.name: Xcode Release Notes Index
apple_official_docs.description: Canonical entry point for current Xcode release notes when command behavior or tooling changes may have shifted.

apple_official_docs.name: Xcode 26 Release Notes
apple_official_docs.description: Current major-version release notes for the Xcode 26 family.

apple_official_docs.name: WWDC25: Record, replay, and review: UI automation with Xcode
apple_official_docs.description: Apple session covering modern UI automation workflows, test plans, and reviewing artifacts. Primary source for Xcode 26 UI automation recording authoring flow.

apple_official_docs.name: WWDC25: What's new in Xcode 26
apple_official_docs.description: Xcode 26 overview session. Confirms the new UI automation recording code-generation system and the Automation Explorer in test reports.

apple_official_docs.name: Recording UI automation for testing (Apple Developer Documentation)
apple_official_docs.description: Apple reference documenting the Xcode 26 UI recording workflow: Start Recording button, query selection (identifier vs label vs predicate), and post-recording review steps.

apple_official_docs.name: WWDC24: Meet Swift Testing
apple_official_docs.description: Apple introduction to the Testing module and its core model.

ci_environment_checks.name: GitHub Actions Runner Images
ci_environment_checks.description: Source of truth for available macOS labels, Xcode support policy, and runner drift when using GitHub Actions.

ci_environment_checks.name: Xcode Cloud Release Notes
ci_environment_checks.description: Current Xcode Cloud environment changes, known issues, and supported Xcode versions.

ci_environment_checks.name: Xcode Cloud Overview and Pricing
ci_environment_checks.description: Current compute-hour pricing tiers. As of 2026-07-11: 25 hours/month included with Apple Developer Program, then $49.99/100hrs up to $3,999.99/10,000hrs. Re-verify before budgeting.

ci_environment_checks.name: GitHub Actions Runner Pricing
ci_environment_checks.description: Current per-minute rates and included-minute multipliers for hosted runners. As of the Jan 1, 2026 repricing: macOS (3-4 core) ~$0.062/min overage, 10x multiplier against included minutes vs Linux x86. Re-verify before budgeting.

snapshot_testing.name: swift-snapshot-testing Releases
snapshot_testing.description: Use this to verify the current package version before copying a dependency snippet. Latest as of 2026-07-11: 1.19.3.

snapshot_testing.name: swift-snapshot-testing issue #1089: crash on iOS 26.2 simulator
snapshot_testing.description: Open issue as of mid-2026: crash in add(traits:viewController:to:) on iOS 26.2 simulator across every snapshot strategy. Check status before pinning Xcode 26.2 / iOS 26.2 for a snapshot-test lane.

xcode_26_testing.name: Xcode 26.4 Release Notes
xcode_26_testing.description: Release notes for Xcode 26.4 (shipped March 24, 2026, with Swift 6.3). Confirms the XCTAssert-inside-@Test runtime-warning change and Swift Testing image-attachment refinements beyond the initial Xcode 26 release.

xcode_26_testing.name: Swift Testing What's New (Swift 6.2/Xcode 26) — Swift Forums
xcode_26_testing.description: Community roundup of Swift Testing changes since Swift 6.0: runtime issue detection, issue handling traits, XCTest interop changes. Authoritative bridge between WWDC sessions and what landed in the SDK.

xcode_26_testing.name: macOS 26 GitHub Actions Runner — GA Announcement
xcode_26_testing.description: Official GA announcement for macos-26 runner image. Confirms arm64 availability, base Xcode version, and migration path from macos-15. macos-latest began migrating to macos-26 starting June 15, 2026.
